title: Vienna Rising Again
author: Ansel Nakamura
blurb: Bram Fairweather, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
